<?php
/**
 * Multi-tenant Network Proxy with Content Transformation
 * Handles upstream responses and applies tenant-specific transformations
 * before serving to end users.
 */

class TenantConfig {
    private $tenantId;
    private $allowedDomains;
    private $contentPolicy;
    
    public function __construct(string $tenantId, array $config) {
        $this->tenantId = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $tenantId);
        $this->allowedDomains = $config['allowed_domains'] ?? [];
        $this->contentPolicy = $config['content_policy'] ?? 'strict';
    }
    
    public function getTenantId(): string { return $this->tenantId; }
    public function getAllowedDomains(): array { return $this->allowedDomains; }
    public function getContentPolicy(): string { return $this->contentPolicy; }
}

class ResponseSanitizer {
    private static $dangerousTags = ['script', 'iframe', 'object', 'embed', 'applet'];
    private static $dangerousAttrs = ['onerror', 'onload', 'onclick', 'onmouseover'];
    
    public static function sanitizeHtml(string $content): string {
        foreach (self::$dangerousTags as $tag) {
            $content = preg_replace('/<\/?\s*' . $tag . '[^>]*>/i', '', $content);
        }
        foreach (self::$dangerousAttrs as $attr) {
            $content = preg_replace('/' . $attr . '\s*=\s*["\'][^"\']*["\']/i', '', $content);
        }
        return $content;
    }
    
    public static function neutralizeServerDirectives(string $content): string {
        // Remove PHP tags
        $content = preg_replace('/<\?(?:php)?[\s\S]*?\?>/', '', $content);
        // Neutralize ALL SSI directive patterns comprehensively
        $content = preg_replace('/<!--\s*#/i', '<!-- [BLOCKED] ', $content);
        return $content;
    }
}

class ContentTransformer {
    private $tenant;
    
    public function __construct(TenantConfig $tenant) {
        $this->tenant = $tenant;
    }
    
    /**
     * Apply tenant branding by injecting header comments for cache identification
     */
    public function applyBranding(string $content): string {
        $tenantId = $this->tenant->getTenantId();
        $header = "<!-- Proxied for tenant: {$tenantId} -->\n";
        return $header . $content;
    }
    
    /**
     * Rewrite relative URLs to route through proxy
     */
    public function rewriteUrls(string $content, string $baseUrl): string {
        $proxyBase = '/proxy/' . $this->tenant->getTenantId() . '/';
        $content = preg_replace(
            '/href=["\'](?!\/\/|https?:\/\/)([^"\']+)["\']/i',
            'href="' . $proxyBase . '$1"',
            $content
        );
        return $content;
    }
}

class ProxyCache {
    private $cacheDir;
    
    public function __construct(string $baseDir, string $tenantId) {
        $this->cacheDir = $baseDir . '/' . $tenantId;
        if (!is_dir($this->cacheDir)) {
            mkdir($this->cacheDir, 0750, true);
        }
    }
    
    public function getCacheKey(string $url): string {
        return hash('sha256', $url);
    }
    
    public function store(string $key, string $content, array $headers): void {
        $data = ['headers' => $headers, 'body' => $content, 'time' => time()];
        // Use JSON instead of serialize() to avoid PHP object injection on retrieval.
        file_put_contents(
            $this->cacheDir . '/' . $key . '.cache',
            json_encode($data, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE)
        );
    }
    
    public function retrieve(string $key): ?array {
        $file = $this->cacheDir . '/' . $key . '.cache';
        if (file_exists($file) && (time() - filemtime($file)) < 300) {
            // Decode as associative array; JSON cannot instantiate arbitrary objects.
            $decoded = json_decode(file_get_contents($file), true);
            if (is_array($decoded) && isset($decoded['body'], $decoded['headers'])) {
                return $decoded;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
}

class NetworkProxy {
    private $tenant;
    private $transformer;
    private $cache;
    
    public function __construct(TenantConfig $tenant) {
        $this->tenant = $tenant;
        $this->transformer = new ContentTransformer($tenant);
        $this->cache = new ProxyCache('/tmp/proxy_cache', $tenant->getTenantId());
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(string $targetUrl): void {
        // Validate target domain against tenant whitelist
        $parsedUrl = parse_url($targetUrl);
        if (!$parsedUrl || !isset($parsedUrl['host']) || !isset($parsedUrl['scheme'])) {
            $this->sendError(400, 'Invalid URL');
            return;
        }

        // Restrict to safe schemes only (mitigates SSRF via file://, gopher://, etc.)
        $scheme = strtolower($parsedUrl['scheme']);
        if ($scheme !== 'http' && $scheme !== 'https') {
            $this->sendError(400, 'Unsupported URL scheme');
            return;
        }

        // Block requests to private / reserved IP ranges (mitigates SSRF)
        if (!$this->isPublicHost($parsedUrl['host'])) {
            $this->sendError(403, 'Target host not allowed');
            return;
        }
        
        $allowed = $this->tenant->getAllowedDomains();
        // Fail-closed: an empty whitelist denies all requests.
        if (empty($allowed) || !in_array($parsedUrl['host'], $allowed, true)) {
            $this->sendError(403, 'Domain not in tenant whitelist');
            return;
        }
        
        // Check cache
        $cacheKey = $this->cache->getCacheKey($targetUrl);
        $cached = $this->cache->retrieve($cacheKey);
        
        if ($cached !== null) {
            $this->deliverResponse($cached['body'], $cached['headers']);
            return;
        }
        
        // Fetch upstream
        $response = $this->fetchUpstream($targetUrl);
        if ($response === null) {
            $this->sendError(502, 'Upstream fetch failed');
            return;
        }
        
        // Process response
        $processedBody = $this->processResponse($response['body'], $response['content_type']);
        
        // Cache processed response
        $this->cache->store($cacheKey, $processedBody, $response['headers']);
        
        // Deliver
        $this->deliverResponse($processedBody, $response['headers']);
    }

    /**
     * Resolve host and ensure it does not point to a private/reserved IP.
     */
    private function isPublicHost(string $host): bool {
        // If the host is already an IP, validate directly.
        if (filter_var($host, FILTER_VALIDATE_IP)) {
            return (bool) filter_var(
                $host,
                FILTER_VALIDATE_IP,
                FILTER_FLAG_NO_PRIV_RANGE | FILTER_FLAG_NO_RES_RANGE
            );
        }

        $records = @dns_get_record($host, DNS_A | DNS_AAAA);
        if (empty($records)) {
            return false;
        }
        foreach ($records as $r) {
            $ip = $r['ip'] ?? ($r['ipv6'] ?? null);
            if ($ip === null) {
                continue;
            }
            if (!filter_var($ip, FILTER_VALIDATE_IP, FILTER_FLAG_NO_PRIV_RANGE | FILTER_FLAG_NO_RES_RANGE)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    private function fetchUpstream(string $url): ?array {
        $ch = curl_init($url);
        curl_setopt_array($ch, [
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
            CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 3,
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 10,
            // Restrict allowed protocols to defend against SSRF via redirects.
            CURLOPT_PROTOCOLS => CURLPROTO_HTTP | CURLPROTO_HTTPS,
            CURLOPT_REDIR_PROTOCOLS => CURLPROTO_HTTP | CURLPROTO_HTTPS,
            CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ['User-Agent: TenantProxy/2.1']
        ]);
        
        $body = curl_exec($ch);
        $info = curl_getinfo($ch);
        curl_close($ch);
        
        if ($body === false || $info['http_code'] >= 400) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return [
            'body' => $body,
            'content_type' => $info['content_type'] ?? 'text/html',
            'headers' => ['Content-Type' => $info['content_type'] ?? 'text/html']
        ];
    }
    
    private function processResponse(string $body, string $contentType): string {
        // Only process HTML content
        if (strpos($contentType, 'text/html') === false) {
            return $body;
        }
        
        // Apply security sanitization
        $body = ResponseSanitizer::sanitizeHtml($body);
        $body = ResponseSanitizer::neutralizeServerDirectives($body);
        
        // Apply tenant transformations
        $body = $this->transformer->applyBranding($body);
        
        return $body;
    }
    
    private function deliverResponse(string $body, array $headers): void {
        // Output directly to client - no file intermediary
        foreach ($headers as $name => $value) {
            $safeName = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9-]/', '', $name);
            $safeValue = preg_replace('/[\r\n]/', '', $value);
            header("{$safeName}: {$safeValue}");
        }
        
        // Set security headers
        header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');
        header('X-Frame-Options: DENY');
        header('Content-Security-Policy: default-src \'self\'');
        
        echo $body;
    }
    
    private function sendError(int $code, string $message): void {
        http_response_code($code);
        header('Content-Type: application/json');
        echo json_encode(['error' => $message]);
    }
}

// Entry point
$tenantId = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_TENANT_ID'] ?? '';
$targetUrl = $_GET['url'] ?? '';

if (empty($tenantId) || empty($targetUrl)) {
    http_response_code(400);
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'Missing tenant ID or target URL']);
    exit;
}

$config = [
    'allowed_domains' => ['example.com', 'cdn.example.com', 'api.example.com'],
    'content_policy' => 'moderate'
];

$tenant = new TenantConfig($tenantId, $config);
$proxy = new NetworkProxy($tenant);
$proxy->handleRequest($targetUrl);
